areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Programme goal is productivity, so no direct link, but one specific objective on climate-risk resilience of road assets and measurable indicators; no defined resource share and moderate impact.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: General and specific objectives directly tied to the area; nearly all resources go to the main component of public contributions to road concessions; indicators include private capital mobilised; high impact and efficient solutions.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional-strengthening component has a tiny resource share and indicators measure infrastructure conditions, not state capacity, so no demonstration of results or efficiency.

not_accepted.name: State capacity
not_accepted.reason: Institutional-strengthening component has a tiny resource share and indicators measure infrastructure conditions, not state capacity, so no demonstration of results or efficiency.

bonus.reason: Resources are fully directed to an action of the federal growth-acceleration programme (road sector), one of the administration's priorities.
Proponent did not indicate the programme promotes regional integration; no points given.
